meta.name: data-visualization
meta.description: Data visualization with chart selection, color theory, and annotation best practices. Covers chart types (bar, line, scatter, heatmap), axes rules, and storytelling with data. Use for: charts, graphs, dashboards, reports, presentations, infographics, data stories. Triggers: data visualization, chart, graph, data chart, bar chart, line chart, scatter plot, data viz, visualization, dashboard chart, infographic data, data presentation, chart design, plot, heatmap, pie chart alternative

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据数据自动推荐图表类型并优化配色与标注
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把数据变成清晰美观的图表
copy.tagline_en: Automatically recommend chart types and optimize colors and annotations based on your data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn data into clear and beautiful charts

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的数据自动选择图表类型（如柱状图、折线图、散点图），并遵循配色、坐标轴和标注的最佳实践来生成可视化图表。
howto.when: 当你要求制作图表、图形、仪表盘、报告或数据故事时触发，例如提到“数据可视化”、“图表”、“折线图”等关键词。

say.text: 帮我用柱状图展示各季度营收对比。
say.note: Claude 会生成排序后的水平柱状图并标注数值。

say.text: 画一张折线图，显示今年和去年的月活跃用户趋势。
say.note: Claude 会生成带标注和填充区域的折线图。

say.text: 用热力图展示一周内各时段的网站流量。
say.note: Claude 会生成带颜色编码的热力图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically select the appropriate chart type (e.g., bar, line, scatter) based on your data and generate visualizations following best practices for color, axes, and annotations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for charts, graphs, dashboards, reports, or data stories, such as mentioning "data visualization", "chart", "line chart", etc.

say_en.text: Show quarterly revenue comparison using a bar chart.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a sorted horizontal bar chart with value labels.

say_en.text: Plot a line chart of monthly active users for this year and last year.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a line chart with annotations and fill.

say_en.text: Create a heatmap of website traffic by day and hour.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a color-coded heatmap.
